tower_gatling.name: Heaven's Archer
tower_gatling.description: A celestial archer firing blessed arrows in rapid succession. Cheap and reliable, guarding the gates of heaven with relentless volleys.

tower_cannon.name: Holy Mortar
tower_cannon.description: A divine mortar that launches explosive orbs of holy fire. Devastating at choke points where demons cluster.

tower_frost.name: Frost Halo
tower_frost.description: A radiant halo that chills demons with divine frost. Slows their advance, giving defenders time to regroup.

tower_poison.name: Plague Prayer
tower_poison.description: A cursed prayer that inflicts lingering divine plague upon demons. The corruption spreads, ignoring their armor.

tower_sniper.name: Divine Lance
tower_sniper.description: A heavenly lance that pierces through the strongest demons from afar. Armor-piercing and far-reaching, it strikes both ground and air.

tower_aura.name: Angel's Blessing
tower_aura.description: An angelic presence that blesses nearby towers with divine power. Enhances damage, range, and fire rate of all towers in its aura.

tower_economy.name: Alms Collector
tower_economy.description: A celestial tithe collector that gathers offerings from the faithful. Generates a steady stream of gold for the defense of heaven.

enemy_runner.name: Imp
enemy_runner.description: A small, fast demon that sprints toward the gates of heaven. Fragile but quick — don't let it slip through.

enemy_grunt.name: Demon Soldier
enemy_grunt.description: A rank-and-file demon soldier. Balanced threat that forms the core of every demonic assault.

enemy_armored.name: Armored Brute
enemy_armored.description: A hulking demon clad in infernal armor. Reduces incoming damage by half unless struck with armor-piercing weapons.

enemy_flyer.name: Gargoyle
enemy_flyer.description: A winged gargoyle that soars above ground defenses. Only towers blessed with anti-air can strike it from the sky.

enemy_swarm.name: Hellspawn
enemy_swarm.description: A writhing mass of lesser demons that spawns in overwhelming numbers. Each individual is weak, but their horde can break through.

enemy_boss.name: Demon Lord
enemy_boss.description: A towering Demon Lord leading the assault on heaven. Massive HP, thick armor, and a bounty of gold for whoever fells it.

map_single_path.name: The Golden Path
map_single_path.description: A single winding road to the gates of heaven. Master your upgrade timing and tower composition on this deterministic path.

map_multi_path.name: Twin Gates
map_multi_path.description: Two approaches converge on a single gate. Split your defenses wisely — both lanes demand attention simultaneously.

map_branching.name: The Forked Road
map_branching.description: One road forks and rejoins before the gate. Choose to funnel enemies at the merge or defend each branch independently.
